CustomField.description: Opens the event location in Google Maps: the exact pin when Location Event coordinates are filled, otherwise the address.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Event"), IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Location_Event__Latitude__s)), HYPERLINK("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" & TEXT(Location_Event__Latitude__s) & "," & TEXT(Location_Event__Longitude__s), "Open in Google Maps", "_blank"), IF(ISBLANK(Event_City__c), NULL, HYPERLINK("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" & SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Event_Full_Address__c, "&", "%26"), "#", "%23"), " ", "+"), "Open in Google Maps", "_blank")) ), NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Opens the event location in Google Maps: the exact pin when Location Event coordinates are filled, otherwise the address.
CustomField.label: Event Map
